newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Backus and Cementos Lima set cash dividends.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Backus and Cementos Lima set cash dividends.

text.p: Brewery group Union de Cervecerias Peruanas Backus y Johnston approved cash dividends of 0.6133294 sol per labor share and 0.6746624 sol per common share, the Lima Stock Exchange said Friday.
The record date was fixed for July 31, and the payout date for Aug. 18.
Peru's leading cement-maker, Cementos Lima, also set a cash dividend of $0.19 per common share and $0.019 per labor share, the market added in its daily report.
Cementos fixed a record date of Aug. 4 and a payout date of Aug. 14.
Both dividends were based on 1997 profits.
